note: Recorded text-mode conversation (Nebius-hosted stand-in LLM, same prompt and tools as the Bolna agent). Replayed tool calls run through the live engine.

turns.text: Hi Kamla, Ruko here, Demo Bank's automated safety line, on a recorded call. Your code word is PATANG 27. Does it match your app?
Your app shows you were on a call while paying. What's this payment for, and who were you speaking with?
It's for some verification, they said... but there's a CBI officer on the other call right now.

args.evidence: A CBI officer is on the other call

turns.text: There's no 'digital arrest' in Indian law. Police or CBI never question anyone on a video call. Did they say they're police, CBI, customs or a court, or keep you on video?
Oh god, yes, he said CBI and kept me on video for so long! Please stop the payment and call my son Ravi.

args.evidence: A stranger on video is guiding the payment

args.reason: The payment was guided by a stranger claiming to be CBI, which is a fraud pattern. The money is safe in your account.

turns.text: For your safety, this payment is stopped. Your money is safe in your account. If someone has been pressuring you, call 1930. Shall I call Ravi, your son, so you can talk it over?
Yes, please call Ravi. Thank you, thank you so much. I was so scared.
I've asked Ravi to be called now. The money stays in your account until you've talked. Thank you for your patience. Goodbye.
